plan.envelope_gate: Both forward and reverse half validation must improve normalized power-envelope MSE by at least 10 percent, with no smoothing/order/root search
plan.scope: Same accepted normalized A moving-tailpipe acoustic coordinate, not crank-angle, physical-source decomposition, RPM/load evidence or listener acceptance
plan.next_design: Separate coherent high-harmonic energy from diffuse/detail energy with replacement, then fit noise-driven resonators to short-lag structure. Introduce a periodic detail envelope only if it validates on held-out halves. No independent fixed HF cloud, generic saw/friction layer or deeper common PM.

causal_limit: Repeat/periodic envelopes describe this normalized recording; they do not identify physical friction, cylinder events or a unique audible cause
